name: LangGraph
best_for: Klarna Uber LinkedIn BlackRock Cisco JPMorgan Replit
tradeoffs: Regulated industries stateful workflows auditability deterministic control human-in-the-loop. 1-2 week ramp. Best for production.

name: CrewAI
best_for: Fast multi-agent prototyping stakeholder demos linear workflows
tradeoffs: 2-4 hour setup. Role-based abstraction. Up to 3x token overhead vs LangGraph on simple workflows. Less fine-grained control.

name: OpenAI Agents SDK
best_for: GPT-centric agents sandboxed tools voice workflows
tradeoffs: Lowest friction for OpenAI-centered workflows. Native sandboxing sub-agents Codex-style tools. April 2026 overhaul added MCP support.

name: Google ADK
best_for: Multimodal agents GCP-native stacks cross-framework interoperability
tradeoffs: Strongest for video voice image text in single workflow. A2A-powered interoperability. Best Gemini integration.

name: Microsoft Agent Framework
tradeoffs: v1.0 GA April 2026. Merged AutoGen and Semantic Kernel. Graph orchestration with Cosmos DB persistence. Best for Microsoft stacks.

name: Pydantic AI
best_for: Type-safe production agents composable design durable execution
tradeoffs: Strongest type safety in Python. Low vendor coupling. Good for teams wanting compile-time validation.

name: LlamaIndex
best_for: RAG-heavy knowledge bases document search internal KBs
tradeoffs: Best-in-class data connectors and indexing strategies. Vector tree keyword hybrid indexing. Often combined with LangGraph for orchestration.
column12: Less natural for non-retrieval multi-agent workflows

name: Mastra
tradeoffs: From Gatsby team. Clean Next.js integration. Human-in-the-loop primitives. De facto TypeScript choice.

name: Agno (Phidata)
best_for: High-throughput agent swarms bulk content generation
tradeoffs: Lightweight runtime. Faster horizontal scaling than LangGraph. Less opinionated than CrewAI.

name: DSPy
best_for: Prompt optimization as compilation systematic LM programming
tradeoffs: Optimizes prompts automatically via compilation. Strong for research and systematic prompt engineering.
